title: IP access control
help: Decides by source IP whether a client may connect, checked before the target is dialed. Addresses banned by Intrusion Prevention are always refused, even when they are on the allowlist. When a reverse proxy or another forwarder sits in front of the rule, the source seen is its address.
setsEmpty: No subscribed lists yet; add them in the global settings of Web Services
setsHelp: Checked together with the ranges above; matching any of them counts as being on the list. A refreshed subscription takes effect at once, the rule keeps running
setsWhitelistHelp: Checked together with the ranges above; matching any of them allows the connection. A refreshed subscription takes effect at once, the rule keeps running. Lists are downloaded on schedule by the Web Services module and count as empty until the first download succeeds
knockHelp: Once a Port Knocking rule is selected, the source address must also knock successfully with fwknop first, and can only make new connections during the access duration; other connections are dropped. Gately checks this itself and needs no firewall permission. If a list is also set, both must be satisfied.
